d: Spianata in front of the castle of Don Antonio de Mariz. At the start of the curtain the scene is empty; they cross the scene some groups of extras carrying deer and other wilds of different kinds: internally odonsi hunting sounds. Then come the Choir of hunters, Don Alvaro, Gonzales, Ruy, Alonso, Adventurieri.
Don Antonio, from the castle, and sayings. He is followed by Armed Men.
Pery to the right, and sayings.
Cecilia followed by some Damigelle, and sayings; indi Pery.
Cecilia and Pery.

The cave of the wild. To the right a large cave that occupies half of the scene, to the left a thick forest; near the cave there is a large trunk of tree broken by lightning. It is night. Pery alone, from the bottom crawling between the spots.
Gonzales, Ruy-Bento and Alonso enter guarding and cross the cave. Pery is hidden.
Pery and Gonzales.
The barracks of adventurers. Room of rough appearance, hanging weapons, beds, tables and rough benches, amphorae of wine and glasses. Ruy and Alonso enter surrounded by Adventurieri.
Gonzales and sayings.

The bedroom of Cecilia. Alcova on the right with bed; large open window; table with lamp; other cabinet at the window, on which a Spanish guitar; door closed in the bottom; a moonbeam floodes the room and is reflected on the alcove. Cecilia, alone, heading to the window.
After long silence I noticed Gonzales crossing the window and entering with caution, and said.

Said. Don Alvaro rushing in the middle; then Ruy and Alonso, with Adventurieri, then Don Antonio followed by Armed Men, Women of the Colony, Servants with torches on; Poscia Pery from the window, finally Pedro.

The camp of the Aimorès, on the edge of a forest, and a short distance from the castle, which can be seen in the bottom. The camp has animated appearance; they repair the failures of the day before. Some women treat the wounded, make cotton, squeeze fruit and pour to drink in the ""Cococo" to the Warriors of the tribe. These prepare and sharpen arrows, and try their bows. On the right a sort of tent of the Cacico, composed of palm leaves. From some stones at the tent rises an aromatic smoke. The Children run from one side to the other, and lend help to the Women. On the left by a large tree is Cecilia prisoner; it is veiled, and in painful attitude. Some Aimorès guard it.

The Hawk of the tribe, and sayings. He stands at the threshold of his tent. He has the body covered with two tread skins, which serve him as a mantle. A great "cocar" of red feathers girds his head; he holds a large clave that gives hard to an old Aimore, and hangs from his side a kind of buccina, formed by a human femur. His appearance is majestic and fierce at once.
Said. An Aimoré drape leading Pery prisoner. One of them holds in his hands Pery's weapons, less the bow that hangs behind his shoulders.
Pery and Cecilia alone.
Sayings and the Cachicus followed from all the tribe of the Aimores.
Saying: Don Alvaro, Don Antonio, followed by a Portuguese dragon.

The basement of the castle. Risked by a face embedded in a pillar. A door at the bottom with a staircase, leading to the apartments. A rough door to the right, which communicates with the other underground. A small door to the left. On one side various barrels of stacked dust. Ruy, Alonso and choir of Adventurieri, indi Gonzales.
Don Antonio shows up with Pedro on the right door.
Pery is said.
Cecilia and sayings.
Gonzales, Adventurieri, Ruy, Alonso and Don Antonio.
